name: Hamburg
summary: A red field with a white castle of three towers in the centre. The castle has represented Hamburg since the 13th century, and red is the colour of the Hanseatic League.
origin: The castle with three towers appears on Hamburg's seal from the 13th century. The red flag with the castle was used by the city's ships and formally adopted in 1897.

symbols.name: Three-towered castle
symbols.description: A white castle with closed gates and three towers.

history.label: Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg

facts: The gates on the castle are closed, a symbol of defence.
clues: A white three-towered castle on red.
The flag of Germany's second-largest city.
A Hanseatic city-state with a famous port.
